stem: With the numerous opponents of the controversial new taxation measure in such a fury, anyone who publicly advocated the measure did not fail to meet with ____ usage.
Although the vast weight of evidence supports the contention that the products of agricultural biotechnology are environmentally (i)____, many people still find them (ii)____ unsettling.

The (i)____ nature of the candidate’s comments is calculated. As a long-standing target of critics who regard him as radical, he understands that he needs to be as (ii)____ as possible if he is to overcome those critiques and appear as a (iii)____ leader.

The new art museum’s (i)____ building augurs well for that ambitious institution because it speaks of (ii)____ contemporary architecture on the part of the board of directors that may (iii)____ equal astuteness about contemporary art.

Science is arguably a very high-minded pursuit, but that is not to say that all of its practitioners are ____, as numerous articles alleging overly generous pharmaceutical industry payments to medical researchers have tried to show.

The town’s air was consistently ____: depending on the breeze, one might be greeted with the sour effluvia of twenty breweries, choking fumes from the coal factory, or brackish smells from the nearby river.
One of the vocalists who auditioned for a leading part in the local production of Sweeney Todd seemed to prefer ____ to any attempt at producing a melody; a more unpleasant voice was hard to imagine.
